component.name: falsify
component.description: PRML reference implementation (Python). The evaluation attested below is its own conformance run against the PRML v0.1 test vectors.

externalReferences.comment: Registry receipt (Ed25519-signed JSON) with links to the RFC 3161 token and the Rekor entry.

standards.name: Pre-registered evaluation claim
standards.description: Two requirements a consumer of an evaluation result can check without trusting the party that ran it. Written for this example; not an external standard.

requirements.title: Acceptance criterion fixed before the run
requirements.text: The metric, comparator, threshold, dataset identity and seed that decide pass or fail were committed to a cryptographic hash, and a party independent of the evaluator recorded the time of that commitment, before the result was produced.

requirements.title: Observed result meets the fixed criterion
requirements.text: The observed value satisfies the comparator and threshold recorded in the committed manifest, as evaluated by a conforming PRML verifier.

evidence.description: The PRML manifest whose canonical bytes hash to 390e78d9…5590c. It names the metric (conformance_vectors_passing), comparator (>=), threshold (21.0), dataset (prml-v0.1-test-vectors-json, sha256 cd7d22ee…2a8e) and seed (1). Recompute the hash with any of the four reference implementations.

RFC 3161 timestamp token over the canonical hash, issued by timestamp.sigstore.dev at 2026-07-30T12:18:14Z. Verify offline with openssl ts -verify against the TSA chain; the token binds the hash to a time asserted by a party other than the evaluator.
Inclusion proof for the commitment in the public Rekor transparency log (shard log2025-1, log index 45932166). Append-only: the entry cannot be altered or backdated after the fact.

Observed value 21 (conformance vectors passing) checked against the committed comparator and threshold (>= 21.0) by the PRML reference verifier: PASS. Anyone can redo this with the manifest and the observed value; no registry access is needed.

attachment.content:
falsify verify manifest.prml.yaml --expected-hash 390e78d9121f8f7a9029d4668d8010df7857c47fef9b06f6b2e6a98d7324590c --observed 21
PASS  metric=conformance_vectors_passing  observed=21.0  >=  threshold=21.0

claims.predicate: The acceptance criterion for this component's conformance evaluation (conformance_vectors_passing >= 21.0 on dataset prml-v0.1-test-vectors-json, seed 1) was committed to SHA-256 390e78d9…5590c and independently timestamped at 2026-07-30T12:18:14Z.
claims.reasoning: The manifest hashes to the committed value (ev-manifest); the RFC 3161 token (ev-rfc3161) and the Rekor entry (ev-rekor) fix the time at which that hash existed. Scope, stated plainly: this proves the bar existed no later than 2026-07-30T12:18:14Z. It does not by itself prove the evaluation was run after that moment, and it says nothing about whether the result is correct.

claims.predicate: The observed result, 21 conformance vectors passing, satisfies the committed criterion (>= 21.0).
claims.reasoning: A conforming PRML verifier evaluates the committed comparator and threshold against the observed value and returns PASS (ev-verdict). The observed value is reported by the assessor; the bar it is checked against is the committed one, not one chosen after the run.

attestations.summary: Self-attestation by the maintainer that the PRML v0.1 conformance evaluation of falsify 0.3.14 was pre-registered (bar locked and independently timestamped before the result) and that the observed result meets the pre-registered bar.

conformance.rationale: Hash, RFC 3161 token and transparency-log entry are public and verifiable offline; the manifest recomputes to the committed hash.

confidence.rationale: Time evidence comes from a public TSA and a public log, not from the assessor. Residual: no proof that the run started after the commitment (a draft execution-linkage profile, prml-linkage/0, addresses this and is not used here).

conformance.rationale: Verifier output PASS for observed 21 against >= 21.0.

confidence.rationale: The observed value is self-reported by the assessor. A third-party assessor re-running the conformance suite would raise this.

affirmation.statement: I affirm that the evidence referenced above is public, that the manifest hash and receipts can be re-verified without contacting Falsify OÜ, and that the limits of what a receipt proves are stated in each claim's reasoning.

externalReference.comment: The registry receipt this affirmation rests on. CycloneDX requires a signatory to carry either a signature or an organization plus an external reference; this example is unsigned.
